headline: 29.7 g/t AU ACROSS 1.8km GOLD CORRIDOR — Odyssey's 60-Hole Infill Confirms Multi-Lode System at Tuckanarra; Diamond Assays Pending
snippet: Odyssey Gold (ASX: ODY) released results from the remaining 60 RC holes of its completed 20,000m infill programme at the Tuckanarra Gold Project in Western Australia, confirming multiple parallel gold lodes across 1.8km of strike. Headline intercepts include 4m at 22.9 g/t Au and 2m at 29.7 g/t Au within the Cable–Bollard–Highway corridor, with assay results from 12 diamond core holes still pending as near-term newsflow. The company is planning RC rig remobilisation into the sparsely drilled Cable West–Bollard West corridor, which remains open along approximately 1.1km of strike.

headline: LAKE VICTORIA HITS 84.54% GOLD EXTRACTION — Processing Route Confirmed at Imwelo; Tanzania Mine Advancing Toward Near-Term Production
snippet: Lake Victoria Gold (TSX-V: LVG) identified its preferred processing route for Imwelo near-surface mineralization in Tanzania, with metallurgical testwork achieving 84.54% gold extraction via conventional gravity concentration followed by whole-ore leach. The company confirmed that near-surface oxide mineralisation previously drilled at 28.71 g/t Au over 2.75m is amenable to low-capital processing, clearing the final technical gate before detailed mine planning and process design work begins. The result materially de-risks the project's path to near-term production.

headline: AIC MINES' $120M COPPER DEAL — 246,000 Tonnes of Contained Cu Added as Mt Cuthbert Joins ASX Producer's Queensland Portfolio
snippet: AIC Mines (ASX: A1M) entered binding agreements to acquire a 100% interest in the Mt Cuthbert Copper Project in northwest Queensland for $120 million — $100M in shares and $20M cash — adding 18.7Mt at 1.3% Cu for 246,000 tonnes of contained copper across five deposits. The project, approximately 150km from AIC's existing Eloise Copper Mine, includes an existing SX-EW processing facility on care-and-maintenance since 2022. A fully committed $70M placement at $0.795/share to major shareholder Hawke's Point finances the deal, with shareholder approval and completion targeted for early November 2026.

headline: MUNDA GRADE CONTROL HITS 38.10 g/t — Auric Mining's October Ore Reserve Inputs Converging Ahead of 2027 Gold Restart
snippet: Auric Mining (ASX: AWJ) released grade control drilling results at the Munda Gold Mine in Western Australia ahead of its targeted 2027 restart, with headline hits including 15m at 5.56 g/t Au from 6m (including 3m at 19.30 g/t) and 4m at 19.34 g/t from 9m (including 2m at 38.10 g/t). Multiple simultaneous programmes — grade control, western extension RC drilling, and geotechnical work — are designed to converge in October 2026, providing all inputs required for Ore Reserve estimation, final pit design and mine planning ahead of a 2027 restart of the 192,000 oz resource.

headline: 100% HIT RATE, 97 HOLES, OPEN IN ALL DIRECTIONS — Goliath Wraps 48,443m at Surebet; 83 Golden Triangle Assays Still Pending
snippet: Goliath Resources (TSXV: GOTRF) completed its 2026 drill programme at the Surebet Discovery on the 100%-owned Golddigger Property in Golden Triangle, British Columbia — 48,443 metres across 97 holes drilled in 94 days with seven rigs running 24 hours/day. The programme maintained a 100% hit rate throughout, including visible gold in core, while step-out drilling expanded the Surebet footprint 12% to 2.01 square kilometres. Best released assay was 13.81 g/t Au over 4.85m; 83 holes drilled in 2026 remain pending assay, providing a multi-month catalyst pipeline through early 2027.

headline: KORYX COPPER COMPLETES PFS DRILL AT HAIB — TSX-V's 1.3-Billion-Tonne Namibia Resource Clears Final Hurdle Ahead of Year-End PFS
snippet: Koryx Copper (TSXV: KRY) completed its prefeasibility study infill and expansion drill programme at the Haib Copper Project in southern Namibia — one of the largest copper deposits held by any TSX Venture Exchange junior at approximately 1.3 billion tonnes. Best intersections from the final 18 holes (7,074m) include 491m at 0.22% CuEq (including 79m at 0.46% CuEq) and 438m at 0.40% CuEq (including 224m at 0.51% CuEq), consistent with earlier results. An updated Mineral Resource Estimate and Prefeasibility Study are both on track for publication before end of 2026.

headline: TWO ROYALTY ASSETS ENTER PRODUCTION AT ONCE — OR Royalties Reports First Gold at Cuiú Cuiú, Imminent Pour at Amulsar
snippet: OR Royalties (TSX/NYSE: OR) reported that Cabral Gold's Phase 1 oxide mine at Cuiú Cuiú in Brazil produced its first gold on September 10, ramping toward commercial production in Q4 2026, where OR holds a 1.0% NSR royalty. Separately, first gold production at Lidian International's Amulsar project in Armenia is described as imminent, with commercial production targeted for H1 2027; OR holds a gold stream covering 3.34% of payable gold on early ounces. Having two separate royalty assets simultaneously entering production phases is an unusual near-term earnings catalyst for the royalty company.

headline: MIDLAND AND SOQUEM HIT 26.8% Cu IN NUNAVIK — New Boulder Train Points to Bedrock Source Along 4km Copper-Gold-Silver Corridor in Quebec
snippet: Midland Exploration (TSX-V: MD) and SOQUEM announced new copper, gold and silver boulders and showings at the Nachicapau project in the Labrador Trough of Nunavik, Quebec, with grab samples from boulders returning maximum values of 26.8% Cu, 0.87 g/t Au and 238 g/t Ag hosted in digenite and malachite veins within monzonite dykes. The discovery builds on a 4km by 1.5km copper-gold-silver corridor identified between 2022 and 2025, with the new boulder train suggesting an undiscovered bedrock source remains within the corridor that drill testing has not yet reached.

headline: SILVER SURGES TO $66.51 ON US-CHINA SUMMIT HOPES, THEN RETREATS — Dollar Surge Erases Gains as Sixth Straight Deficit Unchanged
snippet: Silver futures opened at a six-week high of $66.51 per ounce on September 22 as markets anticipated progress at US-China trade talks, before giving back gains over the following 48 hours to trade near $64 as a resurgent US Dollar Index — at its highest since July — and Federal Reserve rate-hike expectations dominated. The underlying structural picture remains intact: the Silver Institute's World Silver Survey 2026 forecasts a sixth consecutive annual supply deficit of 46.3 million ounces, with industrial demand from solar, AI hardware and EVs now representing over half of total silver consumption.

headline: FRAMATOME BREAKS THE 5% BARRIER — World's First Commercial Higher-Enriched Uranium Fuel Contract Signed; US Reactor Gets New Fuel in 2028
snippet: Framatome signed what it describes as a groundbreaking commercial contract to supply the first nuclear fuel reload with uranium-235 enrichment above the industry-standard 5% to an operating US reactor, with delivery targeted for early 2028. The fuel will be manufactured at Framatome's Richland, Washington facility, which received US regulatory approval in July 2026 for higher-enrichment fabrication. Higher enrichment enables longer fuel cycles and greater reactor efficiency; commercial adoption would require expanded uranium enrichment capacity and represents a new demand layer for uranium miners beyond the current contracting cycle.
